name: greenfield
description: Build the URL shortener from an empty workspace. Shows: full DAG, parallel implement ‖ test-design, design rejected once and reworked, policy-gated large change sets, release sign-off.
requirement: Build a URL shortener service: shorten long URLs (with optional custom aliases), redirect visitors, and provide click analytics/stats. The create API must be idempotent and rate limited, protect against unsafe URLs (SSRF), and keep analytics privacy-safe.

script.comment: Please document the cache invalidation strategy and why we redirect with 302 instead of 301.
